newsitem.title: LATVIA: CENTRAL BANK CUTS REFINANCING RATE.
newsitem.headline: CENTRAL BANK CUTS REFINANCING RATE.

text.p: Latvia's central bank said on Friday it had cut its refinancing rate to four percent a year from five percent.
The further rate cut is part of the bank's policy of lowering interest rates on loans provided to companies and individuals by credit institutions.
The bank said that it provides credit institutions receiving short-term loans for liquidity needs with the lowest possible interest.
It also said that it cut the lombard rate to five percent for the first ten days, six percent for the following 10 days and seven percent for the remaining 10 days.
